sabbath.title: Sihlangana ngosuku lwesikhombisa ukufunda imibhalo.
sabbath.body: IOG ihlangana ngeSabatha ngalinye ukuze kufundwe ibhayibheli ngokuhleleka, kufundwe imfundiso ngomthetho, abaprofethi, uKristu, nabaphostoli.

foundation.title: Yakhiwe phezu kwabaphostoli nabaprofethi, uJesu Kristu uqobo eyitshe legumbi eliyinhloko.
foundation.body: IOG ingumphakathi wokufunda ibhayibheli ngeSabatha ofundisa izwi likaNkulunkulu elingasikiwe ngokwabaprofethi nabaphostoli. Sigcina iSabatha leNkosi, imikhosi kaLevitikusi 23, umthetho wokudla kaLevitikusi 11, nomthetho wobukhosi weMiyalo Eyishumi.

feasts.title: Isikhathi esingcwele, esimisiwe emibhalweni.
feasts.body: Ukugcinwa okumisiwe kuLevitikusi 23, kumakwe ekhalendeni lika-2026.
feasts.note: Ukugcinwa kulandela imibhalo nokubalwa kwesikhathi kwendabuko. Izikhathi zenkonzo zibhaliwe nge-Central ne-Eastern time.

lessonsPreview.title: Izinto zokufunda zemfundiso zilungiselelwe ngesiNgisi, isiZulu, neSesotho.
lessonsPreview.body: Izinto zokufunda zeSabatha ngezilimi ezintathu, zilungiselelwe ukufundwa kusayithi.

footer.lowerText: Yakhelwe ukufunda kweSabatha, imfundiso, izifundo, nokuhleleka komphakathi.

lessons.metadataDescription: Imibhalo yezifundo zeSabatha ngezilimi eziningi evela ku-Israel of God, ilungiselelwe ukufundwa kusayithi.
lessons.title: Izinto zokufunda zeSabatha
lessons.body: Umtapo wezifundo ngezilimi eziningi wemfundiso, ukulungiselela kwamasonto onke, nokufunda ngokucophelela ngesiNgisi, isiZulu, neSesotho.
lessons.archiveTitle: Umtapo oqala ngomfundi wemfundiso nokufunda kweSabatha.
lessons.archiveBody: Isifundo ngasinye sihlelwe ngesikhombo sombhalo, isihloko semfundiso, izilimi ezikhona, nezenzo zokufunda kusayithi ukuze izazi nabafundi abasha bahambe ngokucacile.
lessons.noDownloadNote: Imibhalo ivuleka kumfundi ovikelekile wesayithi. Izilawuli zokulanda aziboniswa ngamabomu.

visit.title: Ikilasi LeSabatha Lamasonto Onke
visit.description: Imininingwane yezivakashi yekilasi leSabatha lamasonto onke e-Israel of God, kufaka okulindelekile, okumele kulethwe, ukuhleleka kokugqoka, nokuhlela ukuvakasha.
visit.expectBody: Ikilasi lamasonto onke lihlelekile, lisemibhalweni, futhi liyasebenza. Izivakashi zamukelwa ukufunda, ukulalela, nokuhlanganyela nebandla.
visit.conductBody: Ukugqoka nokuziphatha kufanele kubonise inhlonipho ebandleni. Lezi ziqondiso zilandelwa esakhiweni ngesikhathi sekilasi.
visit.dressBody: Lezi zimfuneko zabelwa ngokucacile ukuze izivakashi zifike zilungile futhi zingenakungabaza.
visit.requestBody: Lokhu kusiza ikilasi lamukele izivakashi ngokucacile, ikakhulukazi uma unemibuzo ngesikhatsi, ukufinyeleleka, noma ukuza nomndeni.

media.studyDescription: Indawo enesizotha yokufunda umbhalo, ukuhleleka, nobudlelwane.
media.dressDescription: Izingubo ezihloniphekile lapho sibuthana phambi kukaNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.

whatToExpectItems: Ukufundisa okuholwa umdala ofundisayo, abazalwane befunda iBhayibheli.
Ubudlelwane ngemva kwekilasi nabazalwane nodadewethu kuKristu.
visit.fellowshipNote: Ngemva kwekilasi, letha ukudla kwakho kwasemini ukuze uhlanganyele nabazalwane nodadewethu kuKristu.
dressCodeMen: Susa noma iyiphi into yokumboza ikhanda lapho ungena naphakathi kwesakhiwo.
Ungagqoki izikibha ezingenamikhono, izikhindi, amabhulukwe aqinile, amafleece jogging pants, noma amabhulukwe aveza umzimba.
Abazalwane abancane kufanele bagqoke amabhande, badonse amabhulukwe abe okhalweni, bafake ihembe ngaphakathi, futhi bagqoke izintambo zama-overall emahlombe uma begqoke ama-overall.
dressCodeWomen: Ungagqoki amabhulukwe, izikhindi, ama-skort, iziketi ezimfishane noma eziqinile, ama-halter top, noma izingubo ezinezikhala eziveza umzimba.

giving.title: Dumisa iNkosi ngempahla yakho
giving.description: Ukunikela e-IOG kuphathwa ngobuqotho, ukubonga, nokuhleleka. Ukusekelwa komsebenzi kwamukelwa ngaphandle kombukiso nangokucacile phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
giving.mandateTitle: Indlu yokugcina igcwaliswa ngokulalela, hhayi ngokuziveza.
giving.mandateBody: Ukunikela akuphathwa njengombukiso, ingcindezi, noma isiqhwaga. Kusondelwa njengesenzo sohlelo phambi kukaNkulunkulu, ngokwezwi nangenxa yendlu.
giving.workBody1: Okunikwayo kuhloswe ukuqinisa impilo esebenzayo yebandla: ukugcinwa kwendawo, ukuqhubeka komsebenzi, nokusiza lapho kunesidingo khona.
giving.workBody2: IOG igcina le ndaba icacile. Ukuphatha kuphathwa ngobuqotho ukuze umsebenzi uhlale usehlelweni futhi indlu ingaswele okudingekayo.

membership.title: Isisekelo Sabaprofethi
membership.description: Ubulungu e-IOG bamukelwa njengendaba yesivumelwano. Buhlanganisa imfundiso, ukuhleleka, nobudlelwano ngaphansi kwezwi elifundiswa ngabaprofethi, abaphostoli, noKristu itshe legumbi eliyinhloko.
membership.covenantTitle: Abamukelwayo abasengabafokazi, kodwa bayizakhamuzi kanye nabangcwele endlini.
membership.covenantBody: Ubulungu akusona isikhokhelo esijwayelekile. Kuyisicelo esihlelekile sokuhamba ebudlelwaneni, ekuphendukeni, nasekulaleleni endlini evuma uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
membership.observancesTitle: Ubulungu bugcinwa ngaphakathi kohlelo olubonakalayo lwemfundiso nokusebenza.
membership.observancesBody: Lezi zinsika ziphawula impilo yebandla futhi zakha uhlaka olulindelekile lokuqhubeka kwesivumelwano e-IOG.
membership.preparationTitle: Lesi yisenzo esinzima sokuphenduka nokuzinikela kuNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
membership.preparationBody1: Isicelo sobulungu kufanele senziwe ngokuzithoba. Siyisitatimende sokuthi umuntu ufisa ukwamukelwa ngaphansi kwemfundiso, izahlulelo, izimiso, nobudlelwane obugcinwa kuleli bandla.
membership.preparationBody2: IOG ayiphathi ubulungu njengesikhokhelo esijwayelekile. Kusondelwa ngeqiniso, ngomthandazo, nangokuzimisela ukuhlolwa ekukhanyeni kwezwi.

prayer.title: Umthandazo Wolungileyo
prayer.description: Izicelo ezilethwa lapha ziphathwa ngokuzithoba, uzwelo, nokunakekela. Ukuncengela kusondelwa njengomsebenzi onzima phambi kukaNkulunkulu, hhayi njengombukiso womphakathi.
prayer.mandateTitle: Umthandazo wabelwana ukuze umzimba uthwale, uvume, futhi ufune ukuphulukiswa ndawonye.
prayer.mandateBody: IOG yamukela izicelo zomthandazo njengezindaba zokuncengela, ukuphenduka, nokunakekelana. Okulethwa phambi kweNkosi kufanele kulethwe ngeqiniso, ngenhlonipho, nangokholo.
prayer.burdensTitle: Umdala nebandla bayancengela ukuze imithwalo ingathwalwa yedwa.
prayer.burdensBody: Umdala ofundisayo wamukela izicelo zomthandazo ngobuhlakani, futhi ibandla lihlanganyela lapho kufanelekile ekuncengeleni okuhlangene. Lo msebenzi uhloswe ukududuza abahluphekayo, ukuqinisa abakhathele, nokuletha izindaba phambi kweNkosi ngomoya ohlelekile.
prayer.formTitle: Thumela isicelo sakho ngokucophelela futhi sizokwamukelwa ngokuyimfihlo.
prayer.formBody: Shiya igama lakho kuphela uma uthanda. Uma kudingeka impendulo, faka ikheli le-imeyili ukuze umdala aphendule ngokuhleleka.
prayer.note: Izicelo zomkhuleko zamukelwa ngokucophelela. Ezimfihlo zigcinelwa ukunakekelwa komdala kuphela.

contact.title: Bhala ngokucacile ukuze IOG ikwazi ukuphendula ngokuhleleka.
contact.body: Sebenzisa ifomu lokuzethula, imibuzo esebenzayo, noma izicelo zolwazi olwengeziwe ngekilasi leSabatha nomsebenzi.
contact.heroDescription: Thumela umbuzo ocacile ebandleni, bese umzalwane ephendula lapho ekwazi.

blog.title: Ijenali ye-IOG
blog.metadataDescription: Imibhalo yamasonto onke nezindatshana zemfundiso ze-Israel of God.
blog.archiveBody: Funda izindatshana ngesihloko, isikhombo sombhalo, nolimi. Yonke ingxenye ilungiselwe ukufunda ngokucophelela.
blog.body: Imibhalo ye-IOG ngezilimi eziningi, ukuzindla ngokufunda, nezindatshana zemfundiso ezilungiselwe ukufunda ngokucophelela.

reader.metadataBody: Indawo yokufunda evikelekile yeSabatha yemibhalo yezifundo, imidiya eqinisekisiwe, nokufinyelela ngezilimi eziningi.
reader.protectedView: Ukubuka okufundwayo kuvikelekile. Sicela ufunde kusayithi; ukukopisha, ukuphrinta, nokulanda kuvinjelwe ngamabomu.
reader.pdfUnavailable: Ukubuka isifundo ku-PDF akutholakali kule divayisi. Sebenzisa umfundi ohlelekile ngenhla.
reader.browserAudio: Isiphequluli sakho asisekeli ukudlala umsindo lapha.

common.localNote: Lesi sigaba siqinisekisa imininingwane lapha ngesikhathi ukuhanjiswa kwe-IOG kulungiselelwa isigaba esilandelayo.

visit.title: Hlela ukuvakasha
visit.description: Tshela IOG kancane ngokuvakasha kwakho ukuze ikilasi likwamukele ngokuhleleka nangokunakekela.
visit.successBody: Isicelo sakho sokuvakasha siqinisekisiwe futhi silungele ukuhanjiswa kwe-IOG.

venueAcknowledgment.label: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi imininingwane yendawo ingaqinisekiswa ngemva kokuxhumana.

contact.title: Thumela umbuzo
contact.description: Sebenzisa leli fomu ngemibuzo, ukuzethula, noma izicelo zolwazi.
contact.successBody: Umbuzo wakho uqinisekisiwe futhi ulungele ukuhanjiswa kwe-IOG.

membership.title: Cela ingxoxo yobulungu
membership.description: Sebenzisa leli fomu uma ufuna ubudlelwane besivumelwano ne-IOG futhi ulungele ukwamukelwa esisekelweni semfundiso efundiswa lapha.
membership.successBody: Isicelo sakho sobulungu samukelwe ukuze sibuyekezwe kuhlelo lwezingxoxo lwe-IOG.
membership.note: Lesi sicelo sizogcinwa kuhlelo lokubuyekeza lwe-IOG.

foundationAcknowledgment.label: Ngiqinisekisa ukuzibophezela kwami esisekelweni semfundiso se-IOG.

prayer.title: Thumela isicelo sokuncengela
prayer.description: Yabelana ngesicelo sakho ngokucophelela. Uma ufuna impendulo, ungashiya ikheli le-imeyili ukuze umdala aphendule ngokuhleleka.
prayer.successBody: Isicelo sakho somthandazo samukelwe kuhlelo lokuncengela lwe-IOG.
prayer.note: Lesi sicelo sizogcinwa kuhlelo lokuncengela lwe-IOG futhi sibuyekezwe ngokunakekela.

malachi3_10.text: Lethani konke okweshumi endlini yengcebo, ukuze kube nokudla endlini yami; ningivivinye ngalokhu, isho iNkosi yamabandla.

ephesians2_19.text: Ngakho-ke aniseyibo abafokazi nabazihambi, kodwa seniyizakhamuzi kanye nabangcwele, ningabendlu kaNkulunkulu.

james5_16.text: Vumani iziphambeko omunye komunye, nikhulekelane ukuze niphiliswe. Umkhuleko oqotho womuntu olungileyo unamandla kakhulu.

bank.title: Umnikelo ngokudlulisa ebhange
bank.note: Sebenzisa igama lakho njengereferensi lapho kungenzeka.
